title: File Systems
levelTitle: Level 28 - Cisco IOS and IOS XE

cards.q: What is the IOS virtual file system?
cards.a: IOS addresses storage through prefixes such as flash:, bootflash:, system:, nvram:, and network prefixes tftp:, ftp:, scp:. The prefix tells which storage a command touches, and dir, copy, and show flash navigate it.

cards.q: Map the file system prefixes flash:, bootflash:, nvram:, system:, and disk0: to their storage.
cards.a: flash: is the flash device, bootflash: is the boot flash used on IOS XE, nvram: holds the startup config, system: holds the running config, and disk0: is removable storage.

cards.q: Where do the IOS image, running config, and startup config live?
cards.a: The IOS image is in flash or bootflash, the running config is in RAM as system:running-config, and the startup config is in NVRAM as nvram:startup-config; config files and crash info are stored on flash.

cards.q: Which commands list files, show flash usage, and list all file systems?
cards.a: dir lists files (dir flash: for the flash device), show flash: shows usage, cd and pwd navigate, and show file systems lists every available prefix.

cards.q: What do copy run start, copy start run, copy tftp: flash:, and copy flash: tftp: do?
cards.a: copy running-config startup-config saves the config to NVRAM, copy startup-config running-config restores it, copy tftp: flash: downloads an image, and copy flash: tftp: backs a file up to a server.

cards.q: How do you verify image integrity?
cards.a: Use verify /md5 flash:image.bin (or bootflash:image.bin) and compare the MD5 checksum against the vendor-published value.
NVRAM holds the startup config, is non-volatile, small, and used at boot. Flash holds the image and other files, is also non-volatile, is large, and is used for images and backups.

cards.q: What happens to the running-config if the device reboots without copy run start?
cards.a: It is lost. The running config lives in RAM, so on reboot the device loads the saved startup-config from NVRAM; unsaved changes disappear.

cards.q: A copy to flash fails with no space. What do you check?
cards.a: Run dir flash: to check free space and remove unneeded files, and confirm the copy path and permissions.
